snippet.title: Puzzling Places - Monthly Pack #7
snippet.description:
A brand new variety puzzle pack - the Monthly Pack #7 is here! Available today for $4.99 through the in-game or through the Quest / PS VR stores.

The pack covers a wider variety of subjects such as cars, trains, dresses, and even pastries!

For more detailed information about the puzzle pack, refer to the announcement post here: https://puzzlingplaces.ghost.io/m7
